# Poe2SkillsAccessor

[API index](../index)

Skill lookups for one actor and weapon set; the native handle preserves its owner.

**@keywords**

skills, owner, player, monster, weapon swap

## Count

```typescript
Count: number;
```

Number of distinct names in this actor's skill lookup table.

**@keywords**

skills, count, available

## Names

```typescript
Names: string[];
```

Names available for case-insensitive lookup, ordered by dictionary key.

**@keywords**

skills, names, enumerate

## Has

```typescript
Has(name: string): boolean;
```

Whether this owner has a skill with the given Name or InternalId, ignoring case.

**@keywords**

skills, presence, lookup

## ByName

```typescript
ByName(name: string): SkillInfo;
```

Look up a skill by Name or InternalId, ignoring case; also available as Skills[name].
Dread Banner accepts "DreadBannerPlayer" or its actual InternalId "dread_banner" (not "dread_banner_player").
Missing or ambiguous identifiers have Exists=false.

**@keywords**

skills, lookup, name, indexer, reagent

## ByNameContains

```typescript
ByNameContains(text: string): SkillInfo;
```

First skill whose name contains the text, ignoring case; Exists=false when none matches.

**@keywords**

skills, search, partial name

## FindByNameContains

```typescript
FindByNameContains(text: string, limit?: number | null): SkillInfo[];
```

Skills whose names contain the text, ignoring case, across both weapon sets. An omitted limit returns all matches.

**@keywords**

skills, search, enumerate

## Current

```typescript
Current: SkillInfo;
```

Skill currently being used by this actor; Exists=false when no skill is active.

**@keywords**

skills, casting, current

## ByNumericId

```typescript
ByNumericId(id: number, id2: number): SkillInfo | null;
```

Find the exact pair of native skill IDs; null for an absent or out-of-range pair.

**@keywords**

skills, identity, lookup

## BySlotIndex

```typescript
BySlotIndex(slotIndex: number): SkillInfo;
```

Skill assigned to the zero-based player bar slot; Exists=false for an unknown slot.
Entity owners without a player bar have no slot bindings.
The index is not a key code. To start from a keyboard or mouse binding, use World.SkillBar.ByHotkey instead.

**See also**

World.SkillBar.ByHotkey

**@keywords**

skills, binding, slot

## AllSkills

```typescript
AllSkills: SkillInfo[];
```

Every named skill of this actor, ordered by name. Duplicate names and both weapon sets are retained.

**@keywords**

skills, enumerate, owner

## CanResolveHotkeys

```typescript
CanResolveHotkeys: boolean;
```

Whether this player's active bar has readable input bindings. Resolve keys through World.SkillBar.
Entity-specific and inactive weapon-set collections do not own the active input bar.

**See also**

World.SkillBar

**@keywords**

skills, hotkeys, bindings
